info.title: Seiche Reference FX API
info.description: Daily EUR-base reference-rate histories for USD, GBP, JPY and INR, provided by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED through Seiche. Each response is CSV with provenance comments followed by date,value rows. Source: European Central Bank. The underlying reference data is available free of charge from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/ and is reused under https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/using-our-site/disclaimer/html/index.en.html . Seiche converts the ECB XML observations into dated CSV rows without currency conversion, interpolation or economic adjustment. Preserve the comment header, source credit and free-data notice whenever distributing the output. Daily informational reference rates; not executable quotes or investment advice. LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED and Seiche are independent of the ECB; no endorsement is implied.

tags.name: Reference FX
tags.description: Four fixed ECB reference series; no arbitrary upstream URL or dataset parameter.

get.description: Get the retained daily history in USD per one EUR. The observation date and retrieval time are distinct. Read last_observation and staleness from the CSV comment header before using the data; successful retrieval does not establish freshness. Missing dates stay absent. Historical values reflect the current upstream vintage, not an as-of reconstruction. No path or query parameters. Source: European Central Bank. The underlying reference data is available free of charge from https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/ and is reused under https://www.ecb.europa.eu/services/using-our-site/disclaimer/html/index.en.html . Seiche converts the ECB XML observations into dated CSV rows without currency conversion, interpolation or economic adjustment. Preserve the comment header, source credit and free-data notice whenever distributing the output. Daily informational reference rates; not executable quotes or investment advice. LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED and Seiche are independent of the ECB; no endorsement is implied.

200.description: CSV comments include source, units, latest observation, retrieval time, staleness, attribution and free-data notice; followed by date,value rows.

text/csv.example:
# Source: European Central Bank. Reference data is freely available from the ECB; not executable quotes.
# unit: USD/EUR
date,value

403.description: Upstream redistribution restriction; no observations returned.

503.description: Source history not yet available; preserve the unavailable state.
